newsitem.title: RWANDA: Rwanda court sentences woman to death for genocide.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda court sentences woman to death for genocide.

text.p: A court in Rwanda has sentenced a woman to death for participating in the country's 1994 genocide, state-run radio said on Saturday.

It said Virginia Mukankusi was convicted by the court in Gitarama, 50 km (33 miles) south of the capital Kigali, of genocide and crimes against humanity. She said she would appeal against the verdict.

Special Rwandan courts began sitting in December to judge those accused of responsibility in the mass killings of at least 800,000 minority Tutsis and moderate Hutus. The courts have passed at least 12 death sentences.
More than 90,000 people, most of them from the majority Hutu ethnic group, are crammed into prisons awaiting trial on charges of various levels of complicity in the genocide.
